focus: Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, and the Bronx
intro: This first New York page covers official truck-rental locations and labor-only movers in Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, and the Bronx whose own public pages list an address and, where published, daily hours. It is not a complete citywide inventory, and it does not report live truck counts. One-way and cargo-van flags are on only when the location page mentions those services. If a day’s hours were missing, they are marked “Not published,” not guessed as closed. If you already have a truck or container, use the labor-only filter or the HireAHelper box further down the page.

hours.notes: Hours from the official U-Haul of Chelsea truck rental page. The same page places the store at 536 W 23rd St, between 10th and 11th Avenues.

listings.offersNotes: The official location page describes moving truck, cargo van, and pickup truck rentals, and it includes a search for One-Way and In-Town rentals. The same page says a truck rental reservation is guaranteed on all rental trucks; treat that as the company’s published policy, and still confirm that a vehicle is actually on the lot.
listings.visitNotes: Do not treat the reservation page as live inventory. Confirm that a truck or van is actually available for your pickup time.

listings.name: Penske Truck Rental — Manhattan

hours.notes: Hours from the official Penske Manhattan location page. The page marks after-hours key drop as open and includes a one-way rental phone line. The printed drop-off instruction on that page appears to be generic (it mentions 1st Avenue at this and other locations); confirm the drop location with the branch.

listings.offersNotes: The official page includes a “Reserve a Truck” path and a “Looking for a one-way rental?” prompt. Company-wide copy on the same page mentions unlimited mileage with one-way trips. Truck sizes on the lot are not listed as a fixed inventory here.
listings.visitNotes: Do not treat the reservation page as live inventory. Confirm pickup hours; this counter closes at 4:00 PM on weekdays and Saturday, and is published as closed Sunday.

listings.name: Enterprise Truck Rental — Long Island City
listings.address: 4750 Van Dam St, Long Island City, NY 11101

hours.notes: The official Long Island City page lists the address, phone, fax (718) 433-2386, and branch code E124B3, but the “Hours of Operation” block does not publish weekly hours in the public page content we retrieved. Call the branch rather than assuming hours from a third-party listing.

listings.offersNotes: The official location page says it services consumers looking for moving trucks and business truck rental, and it lists pickup trucks from 1/2-ton to 1-ton with 2WD and 4WD options. It also says the location services Bronx, Brooklyn, Long Island, and Staten Island. Cargo vans and one-way service are not stated on this location page, so those flags are off.
listings.visitNotes: Confirm hours and vehicle availability with the branch before you travel. The official page did not publish a weekly hours table in the content we retrieved.

listings.name: Yes Yes Deliver
listings.area: Manhattan · Tribeca office, serves Brooklyn and other parts of New York City

hours.notes: Hours from the official labor-only page, which lists Monday–Sunday 9 AM–9 PM.

listings.offersNotes: The official page says crews can load and unload rental trucks and moving containers, move furniture, rearrange heavy items, and move items into or out of storage. It says you provide the transportation and the company provides the labor. Service is described as available throughout Brooklyn and other parts of New York City based on availability, including named Brooklyn neighborhoods and Manhattan.
listings.visitNotes: The published address is an office location. Confirm crew availability for your date and neighborhood; the page says service is based on availability.

listings.name: Affordable Movers

hours.notes: Hours from the official homepage, which lists Monday–Saturday 7 a.m.–6 p.m. and Sunday by appointment. The same page also says to call 7 a.m.–4 p.m. ET; treat the call window as a separate published detail, not a replacement for the listed yard hours.

listings.offersNotes: The official homepage includes a “Labor-Only U-Haul & POD Loading” service and lists the Sunset Park yard at 4719 4th Avenue. The company also describes licensed local and long-distance moving with its own trucks. This listing flags labor-only because that service is published; a full-service move is a different product on the same site.
listings.visitNotes: Sunday is published as by appointment, not as a regular open interval. Confirm labor-only vs. a full-service truck move when you book.
